---
description: Turn a feature idea into a written specification in specs/
agent: star-spec-writer
---

Specify the feature described in the user's message. Determine the feature name (use the name given in the request, or propose one), then follow the spec-writer procedure: clarify requirements and acceptance criteria with the user as needed, and write the spec to `specs/<feature>/` (`requirements.md` + `openapi.yaml`). Do not write any code.
